# telnyx_wireguard_peers (Data Source)

Lists wireguard peers, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_wireguard_peer`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_wireguard_interface_id` (String) The id of the associated WireGuard interface to filter on.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `wireguard_peers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wireguard_peers))

<a id="nestedatt--wireguard_peers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wireguard_peers`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `last_seen` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when peer sent traffic last time.
- `public_key` (String) The WireGuard `PublicKey`.<br /><br />If you do not provide a Public Key, a new Public and Private key pair will be generated for you.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
- `wireguard_interface_id` (String) The id of the wireguard interface associated with the peer.
